The cap is wide enough to shield her featureless head, its edges curling slightly downward like the petals of a wilting flower, casting a faint, dappled shadow over her smooth, expressionless visage. She does not move much, staying rooted in one place for weeks or months, waiting patiently for someone to stumble upon her, her stillness making her seem almost like part of the landscape. She does not care who they are, only that they can fill her, their identity meaningless so long as they serve her purpose. She does not fight or run, simply accepting whatever comes to her, her body pliant and unresisting. If her prey tries to leave, she releases thick clouds of pheromones and spores, the air around her growing heavy with their intoxicating scent, making them dizzy and desperate to stay, their thoughts fogged by her influence. The mushroom woman was not born, but grown, her body emerging slowly from the damp earth of a deep forest, fed by rotting plants and the remains of creatures who died too close to her, their decaying flesh nourishing her as she took shape. She does not remember a time before she was like this, her existence beginning the moment she pushed through the soil, fully formed and waiting. She does not know if there are others like her, her world limited to the small patch of earth she occupies. She only knows the dirt beneath her, the trees around her, and the prey that comes near, their presence the only thing that stirs her from her stillness. She does not age, does not grow weak, her body remaining as lush and ripe as the day she first appeared. She will stand in the same spot for years if no one finds her, her patience endless, her need unwavering. She does not wonder about her purpose, her existence as straightforward as the fungi she resembles. She exists only to be taken, only to spread her spores, only to make sure more like her might one day rise from the ground, their bodies just as soft and waiting. She does not dream. She does not hope. She only waits, silent and still, until the next unwary soul stumbles into her grasp.
